## Goal

The metadata scanner treats a classified object as a leaf: it records one object entry, never enumerates inside it, and its frontier, pass provenance and restart semantics stay correct across interruption and scope change.

## Deliverables

- Scanner leaf semantics for objects
- Scale fixture evidence
